name: aw-schedule-manager
description: Read and edit your Primavera P6 SQLite database, and build schedules as XER files.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Keep on to remove all tools that edit the database. Turn off to allow editing. After changing it, run /reload-plugins.

auto_update_check.title: Check for updates
auto_update_check.description: Off by default. When on, once a day the plugin asks GitHub for the latest version (only the version number is sent) and tells you when a newer one exists. You can always ask Claude to run check_for_updates instead.
